answer: To resist Sybil swarms, our economy binds identities to cryptographic attestation chains verified via zero-knowledge proofs. Each node verifies its honesty by emitting a cryptographic beacon that roots its trust score. An authentic peer broadcasts a valid signal, whereas counterfeit swarms suffer superlinear stake-slashing where marginal forging costs grow exponentially. Sybil profits plunge to their nadir under this capital exhaustion.
